claim_or_location: scVI row of the embedding comparison: kNN family accuracy 0.629, nuclei→cells transfer 0.622, same-assay neighbours 0.678, same-sample 0.295; claim 'scVI is the only embedding that mixes samples and assays, at the cost of lower within-dataset family accuracy'; 'cross-assay transfer similar for all (0.58–0.65; Geneformer best)'
evidence: foundation_embeddings.npz['scVI'] has NaN in 4,281 of 15,000 rows (28.5%; identical to X_scvi_malignant in dmg_atlas_v1.h5ad for the same cell_ids: max |diff| 0). These are malignant_selected cells with consensus_call 'ambiguous' (4,269) or 'normal' (12) that the malignant scVI model never embedded. Line `Z = normalize(np.nan_to_num(...))` zeroes them, so 4,281 cells collapse onto one point and their cosine neighbours are tie-broken arbitrarily. Recomputed on the 10,719 cells with a finite latent (same code path for all four embeddings): scVI acc 0.819 (table 0.629), nuclei→cells 0.822 (0.622), same-assay 0.931 (0.678; expected 0.765), same-sample 0.413 (0.295). PCA/scGPT/Geneformer reproduce from the npz on all 15,000 cells (acc 0.825/0.757/0.745; same-assay 0.993/0.995/0.997). With nan_to_num on all 15,000 cells my run gives scVI same-assay 0.938, not 0.678 — the published value depends on tie-breaking and is not reproducible.
impact_on_conclusions: Every scVI number in the comparison is wrong. On valid cells scVI has the HIGHEST family accuracy and cross-assay transfer, and mixes assays far less than claimed (0.93 vs 0.68). The qualitative conclusion that zero-shot scGPT/Geneformer neighbourhoods are assay-pure (0.995/0.997) stands; the trade-off narrative about scVI, Fig 6d scVI bars and the notes table do not.
recommendation: Restrict the comparison to cells with a finite X_scvi_malignant (or embed the missing cells with the malignant model), re-run step 26 metrics for all four embeddings on the same cell set, regenerate the table, Fig 6d, phase7 notes §3, README and the caption. Add an assertion that no embedding has NaN rows.

claim_or_location: 'Separability … above chance in every sample (median z = 7.1)'
evidence: Per-sample overall z (ATAC LSI) from atac_separability_per_sample.csv: P-1694 −0.62, P-6253 −0.92, P-1709 2.63, P-6337 3.78, P-6774 4.46, P-1764 9.67, P-1779 11.15, P-1701 20.42, P-6640 23.85, P-1780 85.42. Median 7.07 reproduces; 2 of 10 samples are below chance and 2 more are < 4. P-6774: observed 0.84 vs null 0.83 (one family dominates).
impact_on_conclusions: The 'every sample' statement is false; chromatin separability of the RNA-defined families is absent in 2/10 samples and weak in 2 more. Overall direction (median above chance) holds.
recommendation: Replace with the per-sample distribution (e.g. '8 of 10 samples z > 2; two samples at chance') and show the per-sample z in Fig 6a or a supplement.

claim_or_location: Label correlation heat-map and the claims 'malignant families correlate 0.79–0.95 with each other and 0.39–0.66 with normal lineages; AC-like … the least astrocyte-like (0.39)'
evidence: Each cell of the matrix is the mean Pearson r over samples that have ≥ 50 cells of BOTH labels; the number of contributing samples is not stored. Reconstructed from the atac_pseudobulk_cpm.csv.gz column names: AC-like×astrocyte n = 1 sample, AC-like×neuron 1, astrocyte×neuron 1, OC-like×neuron 2, every ×vascular pair ≤ 1, MES-like/hypoxia/cilia×neuron 0 (blank). Malignant×malignant pairs rest on 3–8 samples. Recomputed ranges: malignant–malignant 0.795–0.953 (matches), malignant–normal 0.389–0.771 (notes say 0.39–0.66; OC-like–neuron 0.77, cycling–neuron 0.72, OPC-like–neuron 0.70 are omitted).
impact_on_conclusions: The headline 'AC-like is the least astrocyte-like' is a single-sample observation with no replication; the heat map presents n = 1 and n = 8 cells identically. The stated malignant–normal range is understated.
recommendation: Store and display n_samples per pair (mask or annotate n < 3); restrict interpretive statements to pairs with ≥ 3 samples; correct the range in the notes.

claim_or_location: 'OPC-like' family used as a biological state throughout Phase 7
evidence: metaprogram_families.csv assigns MP3 (top genes RPS18, RPS8, EEF1A1, RPS11, RPS24, RPS3A, RPS27, RPL32), MP17 (MT-CO2, MT-CO3, MT-ND4, MT-CO1, MT-ND3, MT-ATP6, MT-ND2, MT-ND1) and MP14 (IER2, FOS, JUNB, EGR1, JUN, BTG2, FOSB, RHOB) to family OPC_like. MP3 median UCell score: malignant 0.116, myeloid 0.210, T_NK 0.910; MP17: malignant 0.203, myeloid 0.373, T_NK 0.684. The step-19 exclusion rule (median in myeloid or vascular ≥ 2× malignant) is 1.8× for both, so they are kept; T/NK is not in the rule. In the 15,000-cell foundation subset, OPC-like = 2,500 cells; in ATAC, OPC-like promoter concordance is the only family that fails (0.006 vs 0.016, p = 0.41).
impact_on_conclusions: Ribosomal, mitochondrial and immediate-early-gene programmes are averaged into the OPC-like family score, so 'OPC-like' cells and the OPC-like NNLS/rank/ATAC/embedding results partly measure technical state. This may explain the OPC-like promoter-concordance failure and the uninterpretable OPC-like NNLS hazard signal. Belongs to the Phase 6 audit track but propagates into every Phase 7 OPC-like statement.
recommendation: Exclude MP3/MP17/MP14 from the OPC-like family (or define families on Liu/Filbin marker overlap only) and re-run steps 19→24/25/26; at minimum state the composition of the OPC-like family wherever it is interpreted.

claim_or_location: cell_type_ontology_term_id = CL:0001064 'malignant cell' for 240,603 cells; release_v1.md describes cell_type as 'cleaned TME annotation where available, else scanvi_label'
evidence: Cross-tab in dmg_atlas_v1.h5ad: of the 240,603 cells released as 'malignant cell', 169,492 are consensus_call 'malignant', 70,924 are consensus 'ambiguous' and 187 are consensus 'normal' (29.5% not consensus-malignant). The README headline consensus-malignant fraction is 0.544 while the release labels 77.2% of cells malignant. 2,675 cells with qc_pass = False (qc_fail_reason 'high_mito', Jessa) are in the release with include_in_atlas = True and no release-level flag.
impact_on_conclusions: The release propagates the scANVI label as the public cell type, discarding the atlas' own three-tier malignant call; a portal user cannot distinguish consensus-malignant from ambiguous cells without reading consensus_call. Not wrong per se, but undocumented and at odds with the project's own malignant_calls.csv deliverable.
recommendation: Either use consensus_call to assign CL:0001064 only to consensus-malignant cells (ambiguous → CL:0000000 'cell' or 'unknown'), or document the 70,924/187 cells and the 2,675 QC-fail cells explicitly in release_v1.md.

claim_or_location: Cox models 'adjusted for age + pons'; no PH check; BH within variable set
evidence: Recomputed all six spot-checked adjusted HRs with statsmodels PHReg (Efron ties): identical to 3 decimals (e.g. rank:cycling 1.240 p 0.0563; mp:malignant_OPC_like 1.380 p 0.0041). OpenPedCan molecular_subtype carries TP53 status (62% of the 99 Cox patients 'DMG, H3 K28, TP53'); adding it: TP53 HR 1.66 (p 0.023), rank:cycling 1.25 (p 0.054), rank:AC_like 0.83 (p 0.069) — conclusions unchanged. Schoenfeld-residual check: mp:share_MES_like violates PH (Spearman ρ with event time −0.76, p < 0.001); rank:cycling −0.18 (p 0.09); others fine. 42 adjusted tests across 8 sets are BH-corrected only within set (5–7 tests each); min rank-score p = 0.053 would also survive nothing. H3.1/H3.3, sex and treatment are not in OpenPedCan histologies for this subset or not used.
impact_on_conclusions: Null conclusion for rank scores is robust to TP53 adjustment. The NNLS 'significant' HRs (which the notes already discount) include a PH violation; the notes should not describe them as findings at all.
recommendation: Add TP53 status as a covariate (it is available), report a PH check, and correct for the total number of adjusted tests or pre-specify the rank-score set as primary.

claim_or_location: 'Peaks are called per sample (35k–175k each)'
evidence: No ATAC fragments or bigwigs were downloaded (phase1_tumour_notes.md: 'ATAC bigwigs skipped'). The per-sample 'Peaks' rows are the authors' cellranger-arc peak-barcode matrices deposited in GSE210566 (features.tsv.gz: 60,658 Gene Expression + 35,304–174,602 Peaks rows per GSM); the script binarises these counts and merges intervals. Union 1,022,263 → 279,115 peaks, 22,182 in all 10 samples, 45,226 within TSS ± 1 kb — all reproduce from atac_union_peaks.csv.gz. Gene Expression feature coordinates are TSS positions (width 1 for 43,874 of 44,548 genes), so the promoter definition is as stated.

recommendation: Say 'author cellranger-arc per-sample peaks (GEO) merged into a union set; fragments not re-processed'.

claim_or_location: DA peaks per family (up/down counts)

claim_or_location: Zero-shot embeddings reproducible
evidence: No torch/numpy seed is set before scGPT embed_data, which (scgpt.tasks.embed_data DataCollator, sampling=True) randomly subsamples genes above max_length = 1,200 per cell; Geneformer tokenisation omits the <eos> token used by the V2 tokenizer and uses a hand-rolled rank encoding rather than the package TranscriptomeTokenizer. Comparison is otherwise on identical cells; PCA uses 3,000 malignant HVGs while the foundation models see all 18.8k genes (acknowledged). scVI is an in-sample trained latent compared with zero-shot models (acknowledged as 'batch-aware').
impact_on_conclusions: scGPT values may vary slightly between runs; no effect on conclusions.
recommendation: Seed torch/numpy before inference; use the Geneformer tokenizer or document the deviation.
